creator: fit_nomads_
title: How fit_nomads_ would plan Sri Lanka again
scope: South-coast bases, food stops, safari alternatives, Ella–Kandy train and Sigiriya

method.speech: Full audio transcribed; place-name cards checked against sampled frames

items.details: Arrival and Colombo: The creator would skip a Colombo stay and head south. If arriving late, they recommend The Villa by Contemporary Ceylon, whose name is visible at 19s. Its exact location and airport transfer time still need checking.

One south-coast base, 3–4 nights: Choose Ahangama, Mirissa or Weligama as one base and day-trip to the other two. Ahangama is the creator’s favourite; this is a preference, not a requirement to change hotels three times.
Hiriketiya: at least three nights: Stay at least three nights; the creator recommends surfing and the food scene.

Hiriketiya crowds and season: The creator describes January–March as busy and prefers April–June. Recheck weather, sea conditions and venue opening seasons for your dates; quieter months are not automatically better for every activity.

Yala or Wilpattu safari: The creator suggests Yala outside peak season and Wilpattu during peak season. Treat them as alternatives. Wilpattu is in a different region, so check transfers before adding it to a south-coast route.
Ella: at least two nights: The narration says at least two nights; the on-screen card says 2–3 nights. Nine Arch Bridge is a named stop.

Train from Ella to Kandy: Take the creator’s recommended Ella–Kandy train, then continue towards Sigiriya. The reel does not establish a current departure time, fare, reserved-seat availability or the onward transfer; verify these separately.

Driver arrangement and contact card: The creator suggests arranging subsequent journeys with a driver met through an airport Uber ride. A card for Ashan Cab Service appears at about 99s. Check the original card, current contact details, agreed price and terms yourself; this is not a driver vetted or booked by ReelTrip.
